problem_text:
A city planner needs to allocate the annual budget across 14 infrastructure projects to maximize the total projected community benefit. The characteristics of each project are as follows:
* Project A: projected benefit is 0.157, disruption index is 0.257, allocation bounds [0.099, 0.615]
* Project B: projected benefit is 0.130, disruption index is 0.153, allocation bounds [0.087, 0.825]
* Project C: projected benefit is 0.068, disruption index is 0.050, allocation bounds [0.049, 0.772]
* Project D: projected benefit is 0.122, disruption index is 0.066, allocation bounds [0.032, 0.612]
* Project E: projected benefit is 0.062, disruption index is 0.019, allocation bounds [0.046, 0.571]
* Project F: projected benefit is 0.062, disruption index is 0.232, allocation bounds [0.025, 0.796]
* Project G: projected benefit is 0.144, disruption index is 0.014, allocation bounds [0.040, 0.325]
* Project H: projected benefit is 0.085, disruption index is 0.088, allocation bounds [0.004, 0.898]
* Project I: projected benefit is 0.144, disruption index is 0.130, allocation bounds [0.074, 0.611]
* Project J: projected benefit is 0.106, disruption index is 0.225, allocation bounds [0.038, 0.537]
* Project K: projected benefit is 0.110, disruption index is 0.297, allocation bounds [0.031, 0.741]
* Project L: projected benefit is 0.129, disruption index is 0.230, allocation bounds [0.061, 0.635]
* Project M: projected benefit is 0.148, disruption index is 0.029, allocation bounds [0.074, 0.610]
* Project N: projected benefit is 0.087, disruption index is 0.279, allocation bounds [0.059, 0.678]

Each project must receive a budget share that satisfies its individual minimum and maximum allocation limits, and the total of all budget shares must sum to one. To ensure rapid implementation, the planner requires that the group of quick-start projects, represented by the subset Q = {C, M}, collectively receive at least 0.162 of the total budget. At the same time, the overall portfolio disruption, measured by a combined disruption index, must not exceed 0.191, and the total projected community benefit must be no less than 0.105. Please determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes total projected benefit subject to all constraints.
